source: BrsApi Codal announcements and TSETMC client-type history; marketmap price cache
source_access_mode: BrsApi authenticated proxy; direct Codal/TSETMC endpoints are not used for search/history
tsetmc_api_note: Client-type history retrieved through BrsApi when configured; direct GitHub-runner TSETMC calls are bypassed.
codal_api_status: announcements_via_brsapi; direct report details may be geo-blocked
codal_api_note: BrsApi provides announcement metadata; report-page detail extraction still depends on availability of report links from the runner.

method.money_flow: 5/20/60/120/252 trading-session natural-person net flow, positivity consistency and per-capita value comparison when TSETMC history is available; 252-session coverage is separately noted.
method.fundamental: First-pass extraction of statement labels from Codal embedded datasource; ratios include margins, liabilities/assets, current ratio, operating cash flow/net profit and finance cost/operating profit. Annual growth is not scored until equal periods are explicitly matched.
method.development_projects: Searches recent Codal report titles for project/development terms, opens available report pages, preserves textual evidence on capex/progress/commissioning/capacity/return. Candidate values require report-level review; no ROI estimate is fabricated.
method.request_budget: Two recent Codal search pages per search type, up to two financial report details and one project detail per symbol; request timeout is 10 seconds with one retry. Consecutive provider failures trigger a circuit breaker.
method.cache: Reuses previously fetched detail for unchanged published reports; search metadata and money-flow history are refreshed each scheduled run.
method.limitations: BrsApi announcement metadata is only one recent page per ticker; financial statement/project details are scored only if the linked report content can actually be fetched and parsed. Cell layouts vary; all values are candidate extractions pending source review.

warning: Research screener only, not investment advice. TSETMC CDN may geo-block GitHub runners. Do not interpret an unscored/missing layer as neutral. Coverage of every active TSE/IFB ordinary share is not independently verified.
